package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// Tx hands back a pgx.Tx. A transaction can run arbitrary SQL exactly as freely as the pool it
// was opened from, so it must be covered the same way *pgxpool.Pool is -- a guard that only
// recognises *pgxpool.Pool results misses it.
func (q *Queries) Tx(ctx context.Context) (pgx.Tx, error) {
	return q.pool.Begin(ctx)
}
